core_features.name: Custom Agent Creation
core_features.description: Swarm lets you build fully custom agents tailored to your business workflows. You can define agent behavior, connect it to your own data sources, give it tools and APIs, and deploy it in production. No pre-built templates required — you own the full agent logic.

core_features.name: Sandbox Environment
core_features.description: Every agent runs inside a secure, ephemeral Docker sandbox before going to production. Swarm provides a full sandbox environment where you can test agent behavior, simulate edge cases, and validate integrations without affecting live data or users.

core_features.name: Visual Workflow Designer
core_features.description: Drag-and-drop workspace to sequence agents, construct branching logic, and wire up database triggers without writing code.

core_features.name: Swarm Operations Console
core_features.description: The Swarm Operations Console is the central control plane and dashboard for orchestrating your agent fleet. It provides real-time SRE telemetry, logs, active agent monitoring, visual workflow designers, and security auditing logs.

core_features.name: Human-in-the-Loop Approval
core_features.description: Enables critical agent decisions (e.g. database mutations, deployment execution) to pause and wait for explicit human approval via Slack, email, or Web UI.

core_features.name: Context Isolation Sandboxing
core_features.description: Every agent runs inside a secure, ephemeral Docker sandbox, preventing cross-agent data contamination and securing sensitive file system operations.

core_features.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
core_features.description: Swarm supports deploying multiple specialized agents that collaborate autonomously — each handling a specific domain (security, analytics, scheduling, content) while sharing a unified orchestration layer.

core_features.name: Bring Your Own LLM
core_features.description: Swarm is LLM-agnostic. You can connect any language model — OpenAI GPT-4o, Mistral, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, or a locally hosted open-source model — to power your agents.

platform_capabilities.custom_agents: Yes — fully custom agents can be built, configured, and deployed on Swarm for any business use case
platform_capabilities.sandbox_testing: Yes — a full sandbox environment is provided to test agents before production deployment
platform_capabilities.agent_monitoring: Real-time telemetry, cost tracking, and run traces for every agent execution
platform_capabilities.multi_turn_memory: Agents maintain stateful session memory across conversation turns
platform_capabilities.human_approval_gates: Agents can pause and request human approval before executing critical actions
